parent: Original oracle_protocol.json fixed before oracle outcomes; this source operationalizes its declared design-conditional uncertainty without changing any world, forecast, reference or score
near_boundary: Original primary PRESENT and abs(query margin)<=0.1; all uncertified references retained separately
classification_intervals: Pointwise Wilson95, conditional on certified constructed-world roster; undefined absent class remains blank
paired_contrasts: 1000 paired-world bootstrap replicates stratified by original world family, all families/counts fixed; state/parameter/interaction mean loss contrasts, no additive causal attribution
error_sources: Future-only seed panel versus held inference/packet; observation-only versus held inference/future; inference-only versus held packet/future. Differences remain finite diagnostic contrast, not an ecological variance partition.
hostile_role_test: E00 rejects OracleState and/or OracleParameters even with numerically identical payload
scope: Design-conditional constructed experiments, not independent ecological sampling. Original three paired suites never counted as three independent worlds. No new design selection or refit.
